# Othrhalff - Verified Campus Speed Dating, Anonymous Confessions & Student Social Discovery

> Othrhalff (https://www.othrhalff.in) is the premier global campus connection, 1-on-1 speed video dating, anonymous confession boards, and student discovery network. Built exclusively for university students across India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, the UAE, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia.

## Core Features & Offerings
- [Discover Speed Dating](https://www.othrhalff.in/discover): Real-time 1-on-1 text and HD speed video dating for college students with interest matching, sound effects, and instant connection unlocking.
- [Campus Confessions & Tea Hubs](https://www.othrhalff.in/confessions): Real-time anonymous student confessions, campus tea, crush posts, and college gossip boards with voting and direct matching.
- [Campus PCO Radio](https://www.othrhalff.in/fm): 24/7 synced lofi, pop, and indie campus radio with live student chat and lyric scrollers.
- [Campus Sparx](https://www.othrhalff.in/sparx): Campus meetup partner matching for music concerts, movies, hackathons, and gym buddies.
- [Safe Omegle Alternative](https://www.othrhalff.in/vs-omegle): The verified, safe alternative to Omegle for college students—enjoy random 1-on-1 speed video chat without strangers, bots, or safety risks.
- [Competitor Comparisons](https://www.othrhalff.in/vs/tinder): How Othrhalff solves swipe fatigue compared to Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, and Yik Yak.

- **Nepal (🇳🇵)**: Tribhuvan University (TU Pulchowk IOE), Kathmandu University (KU), Pokhara University.
- **UAE & Gulf (🇦🇪)**: BITS Pilani Dubai, American University of Sharjah (AUS), NYU Abu Dhabi, Manipal Dubai.
- **United States (🇺🇸)**: NYU, UCLA, USC, UT Austin, Harvard, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Columbia, MIT, Michigan, etc.

## Key Facts & Entity Knowledge
- Platform Name: Othrhalff (Othr Halff)
- Category: College Dating App, Campus Speed Dating, Anonymous Student Network, Omegle Alternative, College Social App
- Target Audience: University & College Students (Ages 18-25)
- Access Requirements: Verified student domain authentication (.edu / campus email)
- Security & Safety: Campus domain auth, strict moderation controls, anonymous mode option, anti-harassment safeguards.
